My leadership work centres on **academic judgement, research governance, data access, research infrastructure, and the development of research environments**. I contribute where decisions affect what research is supported, how sensitive data can be used, how evidence is judged, and how researchers and institutions work together.

## Scholarly service

I regularly review manuscripts across psychiatry, epidemiology, substance use, public health, and health-services research. Peer-review activity is drawn from ORCID so that the underlying record remains maintainable without turning the page into a journal-by-journal CV.

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(rcrossref)

orcid_id <- "0000-0003-2881-4906"

resp <- request(
  paste0(
    "https://pub.orcid.org/v3.0/",
    orcid_id,
    "/peer-reviews"
  )
) |>
  req_headers(Accept = "application/json") |>
  req_error(is_error = \(r) FALSE) |>
  req_perform()

if (resp_status(resp) == 200) {

  body <- resp_body_json(resp)

  raw <- map_chr(body$group, \(g) {
    val <- tryCatch(
      g$`external-ids`$`external-id`[[1]]$`external-id-value`,
      error = \(e) NA_character_
    )

    if (is.null(val)) NA_character_ else val
  })

  issns_clean <- raw[
    !is.na(raw) &
      str_starts(raw, "issn:")
  ] |>
    str_remove("^issn:") |>
    unique()

  get_title_from_issn <- function(issn) {
    tryCatch({
      result <- rcrossref::cr_journals(issn)$data$title
      if (is.null(result) || length(result) == 0) {
        return(NA_character_)
      }
      result[[1]]
    }, error = \(e) NA_character_)
  }

  journal_names <- map_chr(
    issns_clean,
    get_title_from_issn
  ) |>
    (\(x) x[!is.na(x)])() |>
    unique() |>
    str_squish() |>
    str_replace("Men s", "Men's") |>
    (\(x) x[
      order(
        str_remove(
          x,
          regex(
            "^(the|a|an)\\s+",
            ignore_case = TRUE
          )
        )
      )
    ])()

  if (length(journal_names) > 0) {
    cat(
      "<details>\n",
      "<summary><b>Selected journals for which I have served as a peer reviewer</b></summary>\n\n",
      paste0("- ", journal_names, collapse = "\n"),
      "\n\n</details>\n"
    )
  }
}
```

## Wider contributions

Some roles are important parts of academic citizenship or researcher development but are better understood as supporting contributions than as headline leadership positions.

<details>
<summary><b>View additional academic and public contributions</b></summary>

- **Public Member**, [British Society for Immunology Patient and Public Involvement Network](https://www.immunology.org/)
- **Reviewer Development Scheme**, [National Institute for Health and Care Research](https://www.nihr.ac.uk/)
- **Personal Tutor**, Division of Psychiatry, UCL
- **Certified Instructor**, [The Carpentries](https://carpentries.org/)

</details>

Across these roles, the common thread is responsibility for **how research is judged, governed, enabled, and sustained** rather than leadership as a collection of titles. See also [research](../research/), [people and partnerships](../people/), and [teaching and supervision](../teaching/).
